Order corrections

Refunds

Proactive outreach

Robust security
SOC II certified, GDPR compliant, and penetration tested by KPMG. Your data and your customers' data are protected to the highest industry standard.
Reliable infrastructure
Built on AWS with automatic scaling and zero maintenance required. Botpress handles peak traffic without interruption — your team never has to think about it.
AI that knows its limits
Botpress agents are built with escalation rules and fallback logic that determine exactly when AI acts and when it escalates. Full context passed to your team every time — no cold handoffs.
Built for the tickets with no script.
Most tickets follow a playbook. Some need judgment, and context pulled from more than one place. That's where Botpress is built to hold up, not fall back to a human by default.
